summary: Cold codegen of the LRE controller: 15 Java files under java.generated.project/src/main/java/lre/, gradlew build clean, all 50 requirements traced. Five items need human review.

issues.title: HCM entry velocity: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) vs 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: system_description.txt says HCM is 'Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)'; LRE-FR3 says 'advises a velocity of 0 m/s'. Implemented 0.0.
issues.fix_directive: If 0.1 is intended, change every advVel(0.0) on a MOM->HCM branch in LreController.step() to advVel(0.1).

issues.title: No-dynamic-obstacle defaults for nsRelDist/ewRelDist conflict between LRE-DM5 and LRE-OP5
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says the four field accessors return zero when no obstacle exists; LRE-OP5 says the Sensor returns 'zero-velocity and large-distance defaults'. DM5 taken literally yields cda=0 and a spurious permanent CAM. Implemented OP5's reading.
issues.fix_directive: Reconcile LRE-DM5 with LRE-OP5. If DM5 is authoritative, CalcCPA needs a separate no-obstacle path.

issues.title: SAFE_LARGE_DISTANCE = 1000.0 and MIN_CLOSING_SPEED_SQ = 1e-9
issues.raw: No requirement fixes the 'safe large distance' returned when no obstacle exists, nor the degenerate zero-relative-velocity case in CalcCPA.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm 1000.0 exceeds every operational distance, and that perturbing the CPA denominator by 1e-9 is acceptable.

issues.title: Transition priority within each mode block
issues.raw: The requirements assign no relative priority to transitions leaving the same mode. Chose autonomous safety guards first (inOpez -> OCM, then CAM), remaining autonomous guards next, event-triggered branches last.
issues.fix_directive: If operator requests must pre-empt autonomous guards, move the event-triggered branches to the head of each mode block (this trades preflight rule6 warnings for rule8 ones).

issues.title: ObstacleRegister modelled as a dense immutable List, not a partial map
issues.raw: LRE-DM3 specifies a partial function nat -> Obstacle. A List maps to RoboChart Seq(...) whereas a Map degrades to real, so a dense list with has(index) was chosen. Index gaps are not representable.
issues.fix_directive: If sparse indices matter, add a parallel presence array rather than a Map.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
